source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:1580): MR > D Latvala Reels @ 3 3/4 ips > DBX Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > DAT > CD and Audience (shnid:124195): two channel mono MAC> ? > normal bias cassettes (see notes) Two 60 minute and one 90 minute mid 70's vintage Memorex cassettes, Cassettes> Harmon Kardon TD 302, Heads aligned to each tape side> Zoom H2 @16/44.1> SD card> PC> edited and tracked with wavpad> flac level 8 and checksums with traders little helper

ai_review.summary: A stellar matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1973 performance, highlighted by an epic Dark Star → Eyes of the World → China Doll suite and crisp sound.
ai_review.review: This release delivers a vivid matrix mix that blends board clarity with audience ambience, giving listeners a front‑row feel. The show shines with a gritty Loose Lucy opener, a sublime China Rider, and a breathtaking 47‑minute Dark Star > Eyes of the World > China Doll journey, plus a standout Phil Lesh solo. While most fans praise the recording’s fidelity, a few note the edited cue points between tracks.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly five‑star reviews praising both performance and matrix sound quality; only one low rating about track cuts, yielding an average around 4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix that combines audience ambience with board clarity; regarded as among the best recordings in the archive, though some listeners note abrupt cue‑point cuts between songs.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Eyes of the World > China Doll
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds strong energy from a gritty opener through solid first‑set work into an explosive second set, culminating in the marathon Dark Star suite; pacing is praised despite occasional editing of transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Fans repeatedly express love for Jerry’s presence and guitar work, though specific technical remarks are limited.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for a juicy bass solo between Dark Star and Eyes of the World.
